name: Blanca
narrative2: In El Salvador 17.7%% of migrants leave for security reasons compared to 3.9% in Honduras and 0.8% in Guatemala.

name: Pedro
narrative2: Pedro now works as a farm laborer. 73 % of the US agriculture labor force are migrants. 11.5% of migrants in our study found work as farm laborers.

name: Rosa
narrative2: Rose's hometown is Santa Cruz de Yojoa, Santa Cruz de Yojoa was hit by Hurricane Eta on Nov. 3, 2020.

name: Gloria
narrative2: Gloria migrated in large part due to the devastating effects of climate change, which heavily affects Central American countries that are economically dependent on agriculture and vulnerable to natural disasters.

name: Sandra
narrative2: After multiple unsuccessful trips, Sandra finally reunited with her family. 8.4% of migrants are traveling to reunify with their families.

name: Jose
narrative2: After arriving in the US, Jose was forced to involuntarily return to Guatemala. 33% of Migrants are involuntarily returned home.

name: Miguel
narrative2: Miguel formerly performed informal work in El Salvador, but he now owns his own business in the US.

name: Ana
narrative2: Ana's family is food insecure and struggling to cover basic expenses. 45.6% of families in the study were food insecure.

name: Luis
narrative2: Luis cited wanting a better quality of life as a motivation to migrate, he wanted more opportunities to educate himself.

name: Juana
narrative2: Juana was able to reunite with her family in the US, where they own a business.

name: Francisco
narrative2: 66.4% of Guatemalans don't want to leave because they don't want their families to be separated.

name: Carmen
narrative2: Carmen said her main motivation was a better quality of life
column18: her family's current income does not cover their basic expenses.

name: Juan
narrative2: Juan reunified with his family who were working as farm laborers. 11.2% of migrants work in the agriculture sector.

name: Reina
narrative2: 1.7% of migrants are over the age of 65 when they migrate.

name: Carlos
narrative2: Carlos wanted to reunify with her family. 15.5% of El Salvadoran migrants are traveling to reunify with their families.

name: Claudia
narrative2: Claudia chose to migrate because of violence, which women like her are especially vulnerable to, 8% of migrants decide to migrate solely for reasons of violence, domestic abuse, and security.

name: Santos
narrative2: Santos migrated because he was looking for work and now works doing various odds jobs in the informal economy in the US. 14% of migrants say they find this type of work once they reach their destination.

name: Oscar
narrative2: Oscar's family can not cover the cost of food and shelter with their income of $11 per month.

name: Maria
narrative2: Maria is similar to 17.5% of migrants who cite food insecurity as a driving motivation to migrate.

name: Marta
narrative2: Marta is 80 years old and migrated primarily to reunite with family.
